8003.description_text: The Menopause Journal is the essential guide to track, target and thrive during your menopause. No-one knows what your menopause feels like – only you. Yet, when it comes to getting the right support, it can be difficult to communicate exactly how you feel and what you want. Well, get ready to take control of your menopause and find the solutions you need and deserve by precisely understanding and communicating your unique experience. This practical 90-day tool will help you identify and understand your symptoms, track the impact of your diet and lifestyle, avoid wasteful treatments, and get results! This book includes an informative chapter on menopausal symptoms and their causes, dietary advice and lifestyle tips, followed by a journal space to track and target your specific symptoms. With daily journalling, you will get to grips with your physical and emotional symptoms, understand how your diet and lifestyle choices impact on your symptoms and be prepared for appointments with doctors and nutritionists. This will ensure you get the right advice to pin down a daily routine and experience your menopause, your way. Written by Nutritionist, Aimée Benbow (BSc, MSc, ANutr) and featuring a foreword by GP Dr Siobhan Brennan, along with fitness tips and exercises from a fitness coach, The Menopause Journal is a complete support tool for all stages of the menopause. “The Menopause Journal allows you to get the most out of a consultation with any health professional. 8004.description_text: Viridian’s Organic Evening Primrose Oil is unrefined, cold-pressed and naturally rich in gamma linolenic acid. 8017.description_text: Organic High Potency Black Seed Oil is made from pure, cold-pressed Nigella sativa seed and is rich in active compounds. Standardised to 3% thymoquinone (TQ), the active molecule which provides beneficial properties, this is our most potent black seed oil.For more than 3,000 years, black seed has featured in the health and beauty regimes of traditional cultures including the ancient Egyptians. Tutankhamun is even believed to have had a bottle of black seed oil in his tomb. Also known as the ‘Blessed Seed’, black seed has a rich aroma and strong taste. It can be taken directly from the dropper or added to smoothies, salad dressings, soups and other food. Viridian’s Organic High Potency Black Seed Oil is certified organic by the Soil Association and grown without the use of synthetic pesticides or other chemical sprays. Made exclusively from organic Israelian black seed, the oil is cold-pressed before bottling into amber glass to protect the oil from air and light. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8022.description_text: A specific multivitamin and mineral formulation featuring a blend of 22 nutrients including supportive vitamins to promote brain health and function, together with bioavailable minerals and selected phytonutrients. Brain Support Multivitamin contains a high dose of choline and brahmi extract at the therapeutic dose. An adaptogenic herb, brahmi is commonly grown in the wet and tropical regions of Asia and helps to maintain good cognitive performance. Used in Ayurveda practice for hundreds of years, brahmi is able to provide great support for the challenges of modern lifestyles.This powerful blend of nutrients includes zinc, iron and iodine which all contribute to normal cognitive function. Vitamin B5 contributes to normal mental performance. Vitamins B1, B6, B12, folic acid and vitamin C all contribute to normal psychological function and the normal functioning of the nervous system. Furthermore, vitamins B2, C, E and zinc all contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress. This ‘oxidative stress’ appears to be a major factor in many human diseases. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. The addition of magnesium contributes to the normal functioning of normal neurotransmission and muscle contraction including heart muscle. Your heart beats on average 100,000 times a day and the carefully selected ingredients in this multivitamin and mineral complex have been scientifically studied to provide daily support. This vegan supplement is suitable for supporting male and female health by taking two capsules daily in conjunction with a healthy balanced diet and regular exercise. It is recommended to take alongside an Omega oil and Synerbio daily for optimum support. 8036.description_text: Highly bioavailable form of potassium and magnesium in a convenient powder format. These two minerals are important for all-round health and wellbeing and it can be difficult to get enough of either in a typical Western diet. Together they can support cardiovascular and muscular health as potassium contributes to the maintenance of normal blood pressure whilst magnesium contributes to normal muscle function.Magnesium is an abundant mineral in the body that plays a key role in over 300 different enzymatic reactions. Indeed, it is often referred to as the ‘spark of life’ due to its importance in the body, and has been shown to support processes ranging from cell division and electrolyte balance through to the maintenance of normal bones and teeth and the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Although Magnesium can be obtained through dietary sources, modern diets with higher levels of processed foods are less likely to contain sufficient levels of vitamins and minerals. Furthermore, intensive farming practices have reduced magnesium levels in the soil by up to 40% meaning that our foods are less nutritionally dense than they previously were.In this formula, magnesium has been paired with potassium - an essential mineral which contributes to the maintenance of normal blood pressure, the normal functioning of the nervous system and to normal muscle function. Viridian’s Potassium and Magnesium Powder can easily be mixed with water or your favourite juice for an easy-to-take supplement as a part of your daily routine.Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8049.description_text: Although 6ft 6in and strikingly handsome, on first meeting Dr Chatterjee, it is his warmth and generosity that impress most. As far from the cliché stressed and perfunctory GP as you can imagine, he makes time for his fans, and has a genuine passion for truly getting people well. His first book, The 4 Pillar Plan, published December 2017, and available to the specialist health food sector via Viridian Nutrition, is an evidence-based, practical guide to better health from the star of BBC1's Doctor in the House. In The 4 Pillar Plan, Dr Rangan Chatterjee presents an easily accessible 4-step strategy for taking control of your health and your life. Everyday health revolves around Dr Chatterjee's four pillars: relaxation, food, sleep and movement. By making small, achievable changes in each of these key areas you can create and maintain good health - and avoid illness. It's not about excelling at any one pillar - what matters is the balance across all the things you do, including: · an electronic 'sabbath' once a week · aiming for 12 hours every day without food · exposure to sunlight first thing each morning Based on cutting edge research and his own experiences as a doctor, this book contains fascinating case studies from real patients. Practical and potentially life-changing, The 4 Pillar Plan is an inspiring and easy-to-follow guide to better health and happiness. The point of this book is to give the reader a simple actionable plan beyond the sort of health advice we’ve all gotten used to – beyond the faddy diets and quick-fix exercises to a lifestyle that gets consistent results into a healthy old age. Dr Rangan Chatterjee is a pioneer in the emerging field of programme medicine, a leading voice in the lifestyle medicine movement and is changing the way that we look at illness. He is known for finding the root cause of people’s problems by taking a broad approach to health, which was highlighted in BBC1’s ground-breaking tv series Doctor in the House. He is a regular health commentator on the BBC and his TEDx talk on making diseases disappear has been viewed close to a million times on social media. The 4 Pillar Plan, £16.99, from your local specialist health food store or via viridian-nutrition.com. 8050.description_text: An award-winning nutritious drink from Viridian, Organic Curcumin Latte is a contemporary take on the traditional turmeric latte also known as ‘Golden Milk’ or ‘Haldi Ka Doodh’. Curcumin helps to control inflammatory responses within the body and also contributes to joint health. This luxurious and warming drink from Viridian Nutrition contains a high potency dose of curcumin that has been standardised to 85% to curcuminoids.Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Vegan EPA & DHA provides the omega 3 fatty acids Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) & Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) from sustainably grown marine algae. Our Vegan EPA & DHA is formulated with South American grown chia seed oil to supply the full spectrum of omega 3, 6 and 9, along with natural orange oil for a great-tasting dietary supplement. We recommend taking alongside our Essential Vegan Multivitamin for optimum support.This product offers a fish-free vegan and vegetarian omega 3 oil alternative providing 225mg EPA & DHA per ml. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8060.description_text: Comprehensive nutritional support for thyroid health with iodine and selenium, which contribute to normal thyroid function. The thyroid gland is a small butterfly-shaped gland in the neck, situated just in front of the trachea. One of its main functions is to produce hormones that help regulate bodily processes such as metabolism. This specialist formula includes thyroid-supporting iodine and selenium alongside zinc, vitaminA, iron, and B vitamins. Vitamins B1, B2 and B3 all contribute to normal energy yielding metabolism, and B2, B3 and iron contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Vitamin A has been shown to benefit skin, vision and the immune system, and the added zinc not only aids in the normal metabolism of vitamin A but further contributes to normal cognitive function. A great all-round product to add to your wellness regime. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8061.description_text: A synergistic combination of three nutrients for women specifically formulated for hormonal balance.Involved in over 300 processes in the human body, magnesium is often named the ‘spark of life’ due to its importance in the body. In this formula it has been paired with vitamin B6 - a water-soluble vitamin which helps to regulate hormonal balance - and saffron (Crocus sativus) extract which helps to maintain good comfort before and during the menstrual cycle.Furthermore, magnesium and vitamin B6 both contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue whilst supporting the normal functioning of the nervous system. Our Iranian-grown saffron, meanwhile, has been shown to support emotional balance by supporting relaxation and helping to maintain a positive mood, making this a popular supplement to support women’s health and wellbeing.In this vegan formulation, magnesium is provided in three different forms: oxide, citrate and bisglycinate in order to deliver the most effective high-strength dose in a bioavailable form. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8062.description_text: Maca (Lepidium Meyenii) sometimes referred to as ‘Peruvian Ginseng’, is a radish-like root vegetable native to Peru. The root grows in the mountains of Peru at high altitudes of 4000 to 4500 metres, making it one of the highest altitude growing plants in the world.Maca root contains significant amounts of amino acids, carbohydrates, and minerals including calcium, phosphorous, zinc, magnesium, iron, as well as vitamins B1, B2, C and E and is often referred to as a superfood. It has been shown to support physical and mental health through maintaining optimal stamina and vitality.Each capsule contains 400mg of organic maca root extract, equivalent to 1600mg of dry whole root, making it perfect for high-strength daily support. Viridian’s maca has been certified organic by the Soil Association and is sustainably sourced direct from the villagers that grow it where it is purchased at above market price. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8063.description_text: Viridian’s premium quality Organic Ashwagandha is grown in India and is a high-potency, full-spectrum extract of Ashwagandha root (Withania somnifera). This adaptogenic herb has been used extensively in Ayurvedic practice for centuries due its wide-ranging benefits. Also known as ‘Indian ginseng’ or ‘Winter cherry’, Ashwagandha is thought to support relaxation and contribute to optimal mental and cognitive activity. It supports in periods of mental and nervous anxiousness and is a more researched adaptogen than shilajit.Viridian uses a highly bioavailable form of Ashwagandha sourced solely from the root of the plant where the concentration of active ingredients is greatest. Our Ashwagandha is grown in Rajasthan in India which has the perfect climate for growing the finest and most nutrient-dense Ashwagandha. It is then extracted naturally without the use of any solvents or chemicals in a way that retains all the natural constituents of the herb in the original balance.Certified organic by the Soil Association, Viridian’s Ashwagandha is produced using green and socially responsible practices. It is also the most clinically studied Ashwagandha available. The extract used in this supplement has been standardised to a minimum of 5% withanolides to ensure an effective dose in every capsule.Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8077.description_text: Supporting a healthy immune system is important for increasing resistance to infections. The ingredients in Viridian Nutrition’s Beta Glucan Complex provide daily nutritional care for a healthy immune system. This specialist supplement combines a balance of four powerful nutrients: beta glucan, vitamin D3, vitamin C and zinc. This combination helps to support a healthy immune system, especially during the winter months, or under periods of increased physical or emotional stress. This effective formula features beta glucan in the essential 1,3/1,6 form which is a natural fibre sourced from yeast. Vitamin C further bolsters the body’s natural defences by supporting immunity, assisting in protecting cells from oxidative stress, and helping to reduce tiredness and fatigue. In this nutritionist-developed formulation, vitamin C is sourced from natural corn and subsequently bound with zinc. 8080.description_text: Vitamin D is often referred to as ‘the sunshine vitamin’ as it is naturally produced under the skin following exposure to sunlight. During winter periods we can’t make vitamin D from sunlight because the sun is too low in the sky. Because it’s difficult to get enough vitamin D from food, Public Health England recommend supplementation of vitamin D to maintain bone and muscle health. Whereas most vitamin D3 supplements on the market are derived from the lanolin in sheep’s wool, Viridian Vitamin D3 capsules provide vitamin D3 in a vegan form derived from lichen. Viridian D3 has been clinically studied at the University of Surrey and proven to increase blood serum levels of vitamin D. Vitamin D contributes to the maintenance of normal bones, teeth, muscle function and immune function. Vitamin D also contributes to normal absorption/utilisation of calcium and phosphorus. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8081.description_text: Viridian’s Quercetin and B5 complex is a unique combination of nutrients including quercetin, pine bark extract, bromelain and vitamin C for immune and antioxidant support. This highly absorbable vegan formulation has been created for those looking to live a more active lifestyle, especially during the spring and summer months. Quercetin is a non-citrus bioflavonoid found in many fruits and vegetables. Viridian’s Quercetin is extracted from the flowers of Sophora japonica - a particularly bioavailable form of this natural plant pigment. 8082.description_text: Vitamin D is often referred to as ‘the sunshine vitamin’ as it is naturally produced under the skin following exposure to sunlight. During winter periods we can’t make vitamin D from sunlight because the sun is too low in the sky. Because it’s difficult to get enough vitamin D from food, Public Health England recommends supplementation of vitamin D to maintain bone and muscle health.Vitamin D contributes to the maintenance of normal bones, teeth, muscle function and immune function. Vitamin D also contributes to the normal absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus. The skin cannot create vitamin D if covered in sunscreen or clothing, it is thought that a sun cream with SPF15 will reduce the skin’s ability to synthesize vitamin D by more than 95%. Furthermore, older people and thosewith dark skin or those who cover up most of their skin when outdoors are more likely to suffer sub-optimal vitamin D levels. Vitamin D2 comes from plant-sourced foods, with mushrooms being a particularly rich source. This vegan presentation of vitamin D has been extracted from UV exposed organic mushrooms. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8085.description_text: Moisture and skin health go hand-in-hand and we all know the importance of drinking water alongside maintaining a good skincare routine. Yet with aging, stress, nutrient depletion in our food, and exposure to environmental pollutants, the protective skin barrier can become increasingly compromised. Nourishing your skin from the inside as well as caring for the outside can help to ensure that the nutritional needs of your skin are being met every day. This supplement is specifically formulated to include some of the key nutrients associated with moisture retention in the skin, plumping out wrinkles and supporting the underlying structures of healthy, youthful-looking skin. One of the primary ingredients in this formula is a patented ingredient from France called Lipowheat™. Although it is extracted from wheat, Lipowheat has been certified as gluten-free as no traces remain in the finished extract. It is a natural, vegan source of ceramides, and contains a class of lipids that are the skin’s natural sealant. Lipowheat ceramides help prevent the loss of skin moisture and provide a rich and youthful glow. This formula also contains pine bark extract and grape seed extract, both of which are excellent sources of oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs). Grape seed OPCs exert antioxidant activity that help to protect cells from oxidative stress. They feature here alongside hyaluronic acid, a naturally occurring compound in the body which binds water to molecules. Our ability to produce hyaluronic acid decreases with age, meaning supplementation can be beneficial. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8086.description_text: Refuel your liquids, support muscles and aid recovery without any added carbs, sugars, or any artificial ingredients. Electrolyte Fix contains four essential electrolytes – magnesium, which contributes to electrolyte balance as well as a reduction of tiredness and fatigue, potassium, which contributes to normal muscle function, sodium and chloride. Electrolyte Fix instantly turns water or any beverage into an electrolyte-fuelled drink. Viridian’s Electrolyte Fix is an intense electrolyte liquid, sourced from the Great Salt Lake, Utah in the USA. Electrolytes are mineral salts which are present in the body’s blood, fluid, and tissues. They carry an electric charge and therefore can affect the blood’s pH and muscle function. Mineral salts include sodium, chloride, magnesium and potassium and these are involved in balancing the fluid throughout the body including the volume of fluid within the blood. Water movement is controlled by the concentration of electrolytes on either side of the cell membrane. Heat and exercise increase fluid loss through sweat, which if not replaced leads to dehydration. This in turn impairs performance as blood volume decreases and body temperature increases, thus putting extra strain on the heart and lungs. The loss of fluid will also lead to an electrolyte imbalance as sodium and potassium are lost through the skin. This imbalance can cause a disruption to the cell’s ability to carry electrical charges. Viridian’s Electrolyte fix contains all the necessary electrolytes in an ionic form as well as all other minerals naturally present in sea water. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8091.description_text: Adaptogen Complex is a potent combination of botanicals which offer nature’s antidote to modern living. Adaptogens are natural substances that help your body adapt to mental and physical stress, optimising your stress response. Siberian Ginseng root (Eleutherococcus senticosus) has been used for over 4000 years to support the immune system, and support mental and physical energy, without either stimulating or sedating. The addition of Damiana leaf (Turnera diffusa) contributes to regulating blood sugar levels, which can often be challenged during times of stress. Yerba mate (Ilex paraguensa) is a species of holly that is regularly consumed in Brazil and has been shown to have stimulating and tonic properties that contribute to the resistance against mental and physical fatigue. The name ‘Spirulina’ is derived from the Latin word for ‘helix’ or ‘spiral’, denoting the physical configuration of the organism when it forms swirling, microscopic strands.Spirulina is 69 percent complete protein, with all the essential amino acids in perfect balance. In comparison, beef is only 22 percent protein. Spirulina also provides high concentrations of many other nutrients – amino acids, chelated minerals, pigments, rhamnose sugars (complex natural plant sugars), trace elements, enzymes (SOD), and essential fatty acids (both linoleic and linolenic acid) – that are all in an easily assimilable form. Spirulina is one of the blue-green algae due to the presence of both chlorophyll (green) and phycocyanin (blue) pigments in its cellular structure.Spirulina lacks cellulose cell walls, unlike other blue/green algae, therefore it can be easily digested. 8133.description_text: Organic Chlorella from Viridian Nutrition delivers a therapeutic dose of 400mg broken cell wall chlorella in every capsule and has been certified Organic by the Soil Association. Chlorella is a single-celled microalgae which grows naturally in freshwater bodies across the globe. It is a type of phytoplankton - free floating aquatic plants which create their own energy from sunlight using the green photosynthetic pigment chlorophyll. Chlorella is a source of iron and zinc which both contribute to the normal function of the immune system and normal cognitive function. It also contains vitamins C and E, both of which contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress and the B vitamins B1, B2, B6, and B12 to contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism, thus enhancing energy and vitality.Viridian’s Organic Chlorella is grown and harvested on the island of Hainan in the South China Sea. The warm and bright climate here is ideal for cultivating chlorella, and the surrounding area is made up of natural forest meaning there is no risk of contamination from agricultural runoff. The freshwater ponds are filled with water extracted from deep below the ground, which is carefully filtered before use to ensure it is completely pure. No chemical pesticides or herbicides are used, and it is allowed to grow outside under natural sunlight. The chlorella is carefully washed by hand then rapidly dried, preserving the maximum amount of nutrients. This dry powder is then milled to break the insoluble chlorella cell walls, which cannot be broken down by the human digestive system. Cysteine is a non-essential amino acid and one of 12 amino acids that can be produced naturally by the body. Provided in the form of N-acetyl L-cysteine, it provides stability and increased bioavailability for the body to utilise.This is supported by a second amino acid, L-Glutamine. This is the most common amino acid and is found in large amounts in the muscles. Foods that contain L-Glutamine include red meat, dairy products and fish. The addition of chromium contributes to the maintenance of normal blood glucose levels. Lastly, cinnamon, also known as ‘sweet wood’, is the brown bark of the cinnamon tree that is dried and ground into a powder. This spice been well studied clinically and has a long history of use in both Eastern and Western cultures. Sourced from India, it is standardised to provide 20% polyphenols. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8144.description_text: Methyl sulfonyl methane (MSM) is a naturally occurring nutrient that is a sulphur compound found in foods such as fruit, corn, tea and coffee. Sulphur is present in all living organisms and is an important element in more than 150 compounds in the body and is stored in every cell of the body, particularly the hair, nails and connective tissues of joints and skin. In this supplement, a therapeutic dose of MSM works synergistically with glucosamine sulphate 2KCl in a convenient one-a-day capsule formulation. Glucosamine is produced naturally in the joints of the body and is classed as a glycosaminoglycan which is a carbohydrate-amino acid molecule. It is a key structural component of joint tissue. Although it is naturally present in the joints of the body, our natural levels of it begin to fall as we get older. As it is rarely found in natural food sources the easiest way to increase glucosamine intake is via supplementation. Most glucosamine supplements on the market are derived from shellfish, however Viridian only use a vegan form of glucosamine as Glucosamine Sulphate 2KCl. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. This has been added to Boswellia, a herbal extract from tree resin - also known as frankincense - which supports joint flexibility and helps to maintain joint health. The addition of turmeric helps to control inflammatory responses within the body and contributes to joint health. This revered spice has a long history of use stemming from Ayurvedic practice and is still used widely across the world today to address a variety of issues. Vitamin C plays an essential role in numerous areas of human health, including contributing to collagen formation for the normal function of bones, cartilage, skin, gums and teeth. The formulation includes manganese to contribute to the normal formation of connective tissue and aids in the maintenance of normal bones. We recommend taking daily alongside Viridian’s Joint Omega Oil for the optimum in nutritional support for joint health. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8146.description_text: Co-enzyme Q10 is produced naturally in the body and found in the mitochondria inside every cell. The highest concentration of CoQ10 is found in the organs that have the highest energy requirements, such as the heart, liver, kidneys and lungs. As we age our bodies naturally produce less Co-Q10, but it is possible to increase intake through diet or supplementation and can be found in foods such as fatty fish, broccoli, cauliflower, oranges, strawberries and peanuts. The CoQ10 in this supplement is in the form of ubiquinone. This is a much more stable form of CoQ10 than ubiquinol, and converted to ubiquinol once in the body. CoQ10 is lipophilic which means ‘fat loving’. As a result, it has been paired in this formulation with medium chain triglycerides (MCTs) from coconut oil which aid in the absorption of CoQ10. Available in three strengths; 30mg, 100mg, or 200mg, providing an option for every lifestyle.Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. As we age our bodies naturally produce less Co-Q10, but it is possible to increase intake through diet or supplementation and can be found in foods such as fatty fish, broccoli, cauliflower, oranges, strawberries and peanuts. The CoQ10 in this supplement is in the form of ubiquinone. This is a much more stable form of CoQ10 than ubiquinol, and converted to ubiquinol once in the body. CoQ10 is lipophilic which means ‘fat loving’. As a result, it has been paired in this formulation with medium chain triglycerides (MCTs) from coconut oil which aid in the absorption of CoQ10. Available in three strengths; 30mg, 100mg, or 200mg, providing an option for every lifestyle.Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8149.description_text: A high potency, balanced formula offering nutritional support for sports enthusiasts. Appropriate for those involved in regular strenuous physical activities such as aerobic exercise, weight training, circuit training, body building, running and professional sporting events.This speciality supplement includes 31 vitamins, minerals and botanicals, including green tea extract, coenzyme Q10, iodine, zinc, selenium and high levels of B12. B-vitamins, along with biotin, copper, iron, and iodine all contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism, whilst the addition of folic acid and B12 contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Vitamin C and vitamin E are important as they contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress that can be caused by exercise. This formula also includes calcium, magnesium and vitamin D to support bone health.B-vitamins are water soluble which means they cannot be stored by the body and need replenishing regularly. Sweating from exercise causes water to be lost faster, and thus nutritional needs may be greater. On the other hand, nutrients such as Co-Q10, vitamin E, vitamin D and vitamin K are fat soluble, meaning they are absorbed with the other fats from the food you consume. As a result, this formula includes MCT to aid in the absorption of these nutrients.This vegan two-a-day supplement is an excellent high potency multivitamin and mineral formula to complement and boost the activity of protein powders and sports drinks. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8150.description_text: Award-winning Pregnancy Multivitamin from Viridian Nutrition is a specially formulated vitamin supplement with a combination of 27 essential nutrients designed to support the way your body naturally works during pregnancy.Contains 100% active ingredients providing the vitamin and mineral nutritional building blocks for mother and baby. Includes 400μg of folic acid which is the Government’s recommended daily amount to support foetal development. Supplemental folic acid intake increases maternal folate status to help support normal brain and spinal development of children. Folate also contributes to maternal tissue growth during pregnancy.Additionally, Pregnancy Multivitamin contains researched levels of iron to contribute to cognitive development, iodine which contributes to the normal growth of children as well as vitamin D which is needed for the normal growth and development of bones in children. Vitamin C has been included to support the immune system, whilst the addition of vitamins B5 and B12 contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. The addition of beta carotene enables the body to safely produce appropriate levels vitamin A which is a particularly important for vision, skin and immune health. Suitable to take in trimesters 1, 2 and 3 as well as after birth when breastfeeding, Pregnancy Multivitamin provides vitamins and minerals which work in conjunction with your body’s natural rhythm and helps support a healthy diet and lifestyle. We recommend taking Pregnancy Multivitamin alongside Viridian Pregnancy Omega Oil and Pregnancy Biotic for optimum nutrition. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Due to the inclusion of natural plant ingredients, the colour can vary from batch to batch. All ingredients are sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8151.description_text: This formulation is specifically designed to provide the essential and appropriate nutrients to support a woman of reproductive age. Ideally, take at least 90 days ahead of planned conception. High Potency Fertility for Women contains a combination of 18 vitamins, minerals and antioxidants tailored for women preparing for conception and trying for a baby. Formulated by expert nutritionists, this targeted formula includes folic acid at an appropriate level to increase maternal folate status. Low maternal folate status is a risk factor in the development of neural tube defects in the developing foetus.This formula also includes zinc, a trace mineral known to contribute to normal fertility and reproduction, along with vitamin B6 to support the regulation of hormonal activity. It also includes iron bisglycinate, a form of iron that is gentle on the digestive system. Iron contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue and contributes to normal cognitive function.Zinc, copper, selenium and vitamin C all contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress as well as contributing to the normal function of the immune system. This ‘oxidative stress’ appears to be a major factor in many human diseases.This two-a-day vegan formula is a great way to support your body for good pre-conception health. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8152.description_text: A premium multivitamin formulated to include optimum amounts and presentations of vitamins, minerals, co-factors and plant extracts. This two-a-day supplement is ideal for those with especially busy lifestyles who want to look and feel their best. Offering a full spectrum of B-vitamins to support energy production, cell division and the nervous system. Iodine and iron free.‘Phytonutrients’ translates as ‘plant nutrients’. They are natural compounds which are produced by plants to help protect them from threats such a fungi, parasites and the sun. Some common ones include carotenoids, flavonoids, isoflavones, proanthocyanidins, phytoestrogens, and polyphenols. Together with vitamins and minerals, they are able to offer excellent nutritional support for all-round daily wellbeing.This advanced multivitamin formula provides carotenoids from Dunaliella salina algae, along with proanthocyanidins from grape seed extract and pine bark extract. Important vitamins B5, B6, B12 and C, which contribute to the normal function of the nervous system and the reduction of tiredness and fatigue have also been included in the formulation. We recommend taking alongside a daily dose of 100% Organic Golden Flaxseed Oil for optimum results. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8153.description_text: One-a-day best-selling multivitamin and mineral from Viridian Nutrition. The ‘High Five’ refers to the higher level of Vitamin B5 (pantothenic acid) found in this formula. Vitamin B5 contributes to normal mental performance and a reduction in tiredness and fatigue. Vitamin B5 also contributes to the normal synthesis and metabolism of steroid hormones, vitamin D and some neurotransmitters. This supplement also features buffered vitamin C, vegan vitamin D, natural source carotenoids, balanced B-complex, fully-reacted chelated minerals including selenium, chromium, iron and zinc. Selenium contributes to normal maintenance of hair and nails, the normal function of the immune system, normal thyroid function and for the protection of cells from oxidative stress. This ‘oxidative stress’ appears to be a major factor in many human diseases. Chromium contributes to the maintenance of normal blood glucose levels. This formula contains iron bisglycinate, a form of iron that is gentle on the digestive system. Iron contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue and contributes to normal cognitive function. It is also essential for the healthy production of haemoglobin and red blood cells. Zinc is a mineral essential to many body processes including the maintenance of normal cognitive function, vision, fertility and reproduction, hair, skin and nails and the immune system. Zinc also contributes to the normal metabolism of fatty acids and macronutrients. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8154.description_text: Highly absorbable, synergistic balance of key nutrients involved in immune maintenance and skin health. This formula also includes copper and beta carotene for optimum absorption and utilisation. Zinc is a mineral that is found in every cell of the body and is a component in over 200 enzymes. Its myriad of proven health benefits for the human body include supporting immunity and cognitive functions, as well as helping to keep bones, eyes, skin, hair and nails in good condition. Zinc also contributes to normal fertility and reproductive health in men and women. Foods typically high in zinc include meat, shellfish, dairy foods and wholegrain products. Zinc is not stored by the body, so having a regular intake of this mineral is important. The inclusion of beta carotene in this supplement enables the body to produce vitamin A which enhances synergy for supporting immune function, along with visual, skin and reproductive health. Copper has been added to ensure the appropriate ratio of zinc to copper is maintained within the body to enable the effective absorption of both minerals.Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8156.description_text: Selenium is an essential trace mineral which supports the immune system and protects cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals. 8159.description_text: Iron is a mineral that is essential for the healthy production of haemoglobin and red blood cells. Balanced Iron Complex contains iron bisglycinate, a form of iron that is gentle on the digestive system. This formula also includes synergistic vitamin C to enhance iron absorption and aid in the maintenance of the immune system alongside vitamin B12 - an essential nutrient which contributes to normal energy-yielding metabolism and red blood cell formation, supporting the role of iron within the body.Iron contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue and contributes to normal cognitive function. Foods typically high in iron include red meat, shellfish, pumpkin seeds, and spinach. However, according to the World Health Organization, iron is the nutrient that both women and men are most likely to be deficient in. Low iron levels could lead to feelings of fatigue, dizziness and weakness - symptoms which are often compounded by the menstrual cycle or from following a vegan or vegetarian diet. 8160.description_text: Chromium is an important mineral that contributes to the maintenance of normal blood glucose levels. Chromium GTF refers to Glucose Tolerance Factor, which is the biologically active form of chromium originally identified in brewer’s yeast. Chromium picolinate is a bio-available form of chromium, meaning it is well absorbed and has been shown to contribute to normal macronutrient metabolism. In this complex, the chromium has been combined with zinc and alpha lipoic acid to create a dietary supplement for nutritional wellbeing.Zinc is a mineral essential to many body processes including the maintenance of normal cognitive function, vision, fertility and reproduction, hair, skin and nails and the immune system. Zinc also contributes to the normal metabolism of fatty acids and macronutrients. Alpha lipoic acid is an organic compound that is made naturally in the body and found within every cell. The body makes small amounts of alpha lipoic acid on its own but levels can be increased through diet or supplementation. Alpha lipoic acid is both fat and water soluble, making it easy for the body to utilise. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8161.description_text: Viridian’s Calcium, Magnesium and Zinc powder is a highly absorbable, synergistic balance of key nutrients involved in bone health. This formula also includes vitamin C and malic acid for optimum absorption and utilisation. Zinc is a mineral that is found in every cell of the body and is a component in over 200 enzymes. Its myriad of proven health benefits for the human body include supporting immunity and cognitive functions, as well as helping to keep bones, eyes, skin, hair and nails in good condition. Zinc also contributes to normal fertility and reproductive health in men and women. Zinc is not stored by the body, so having a regular intake of this mineral is important. Calcium is involved in numerous vital functions throughout the body, including bone building, blood clotting, energy production, nerve transmission and neuro-muscular activity. Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the body; up to 99% of the body’s calcium supply is stored in the bones and teeth where it supports their structure and function. Finally, Magnesium is critical for many cellular reactions including energy production, protein synthesis and cellular replication. It is often referred to as the ‘spark of life’ due to its involvement in over 300 different enzymatic processes, and yet many people find it difficult to get enough magnesium in their normal daily diet. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Calcium is involved in numerous vital functions throughout the body, including bone building, blood clotting, energy production, nerve transmission and neuro-muscular activity. Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the body; up to 99% of the body’s calcium supply is stored in the bones and teeth where it supports their structure and function.Magnesium too is critical for many cellular reactions including energy production, protein synthesis and cellular replication. It is often referred to as the ‘spark of life’ due to its involvement in over 300 different enzymatic processes, and yet many people find it difficult to get enough magnesium in their normal daily diet. Calcium and magnesium both contribute to normal muscle function. Boron is a trace mineral that can be found in whole foods such as beans, nuts and grains, as well as fruits such as berries, oranges and grapes. It works synergistically with magnesium and calcium, along with vitamin C which contributes to collagen formation for the normal function of bones, cartilage, skin and teeth. Viridian’s Calcium, Magnesium and Boron powder supplement is easy to mix with water or your favourite juice to make an easy-to-take daily health supplement. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. This product is sold by weight not by volume. Please be aware that settling will occur. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8163.description_text: Organic Mineral Complex from Viridian offers a natural source of more than 80 essential trace and macro minerals for everyday supplementation. This formula features organic nettle leaf (Urtica dioica), organic horsetail herb (equisteium arvense), organic seaweed (Ascophyllum nodosum) and wild-harvested Aquamin (lithothamnion calcareum). The broad range of naturally present minerals within this formulation can help to fill the nutritional void caused by a lack of macro and trace minerals often found within the typical western diet.The hero of this complex is aquamin; a red algae-derived mineral source sustainably harvested off the west coast of Ireland. It is naturally rich in calcium and magnesium, along with 74 further trace minerals including manganese, selenium and zinc - all assimilated from seawater.Harvested in Scotland, wild seaweed draws an incomparable wealth of macro-elements and trace elements directly from the seawater. Notably, seaweed is naturally rich in Iodine, an important mineral which contributes to normal thyroid function. Nettle is also well known for being a valuable source of minerals, including iron, calcium and silica, whilst horsetail is a good source of silica.This supplement has been certified organic by the Soil Association, meaning it is good for the planet and for you.Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. As well as providing stand-alone benefits, calcium and vitamin D work synergistically to reduce the loss of bone mineral in postmenopausal women. 8165.description_text: Viridian’s Ultimate Beauty range has been specifically designed to improve the health and appearance of skin, hair and nails by nourishing your body from the inside. Viridian’s 100% Organic Beauty oil is a highly nutritious oil designed for everyday use. This balance of vegan friendly omega 3, omega 6, and omega 9 fatty acids come from 100% plant-based ingredients and form the basis for this pleasant-tasting oil.Omega 3, 6 and 9 fatty acids are essential fatty acids, meaning they cannot be produced by the body but instead must come from diet or supplementation. This oil combines omega 3 in the form of alpha linolenic acid (ALA) which contributes towards the maintenance of normal blood cholesterol levels, with omega 6 gamma linolenic acid (GLA) and a small amount of omega 9. The natural ingredients provide a broad range of nutrients including vitamin E (full spectrum of tocopherols and tocotrienols) and carotenoids (alpha-carotene, beta carotene and lutein). Vitamin E has a role in the protection of cells from oxidative stress. This ‘oxidative stress’ appears to be a major factor in many human diseases.This oil has been cold-pressed and bottled in amber glass bottles under a blanket of nitrogen to protect the oil from air and light. Grown to Soil Association organic standards. We recommend taking alongside Viridian’s Ultimate Beauty Complex capsules for a comprehensive supplement regime. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. Just to make you aware we are currently updating our packaging so your supplement may look a little different. Please don't worry, it's the same goodness inside. 8167.description_text: Viridian’s 100% Organic Omega 3:6:9 oil is a highly nutritious oil designed for everyday use. Vitamin E has a role in the protection of cells from oxidative stress. This ‘oxidative stress’ appears to be a major factor in many human diseases.Cold-pressed and bottled in amber glass bottles under a blanket of nitrogen to protect the oil from air and light. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 8176.description_text: Vitamin E has a role in the protection of cells from oxidative stress. This ‘oxidative stress’ appears to be a major factor in many human diseases. Vitamin E protects the cells from the damage of free radicals; molecules with unpaired electrons that cause damage to cells and can contribute to the development of disease. Vitamin E is found naturally in a variety of foods, including nuts, nut oils, olive oil, leafy green vegetables and avocados. It is a fat-soluble vitamin, meaning that your body stores it and uses it when it needs to. This supplement has been formulated using d-alpha tocopherol, which is a naturally sourced form of vitamin E extracted from soya bean oil. Natural vitamin E is better absorbed and utilised than synthetic forms as it is recognised by the body. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil.
